company.shortDescription: Graph AI develops a pharmacovigilance platform that supports patient safety and regulatory operations across the pharmaceutical lifecycle.
company.description: Graph AI develops an AI-based pharmacovigilance platform that supports patient safety and regulatory operations across the pharmaceutical lifecycle. Its platform automates safety-data intake, case processing, evidence organization, validation, and regulatory reporting while connecting information through a unified knowledge graph. Products include tools for ingesting and classifying safety cases, building submission-ready case records, generating E2B(R3) reports, identifying safety signals, and maintaining audit trails and regulatory compliance. The system incorporates human review and oversight throughout workflows, allowing clinical and regulatory teams to validate information, review decisions, and manage exceptions.
